band.why: S119: Patterson day140 chooses direct; deleting time from the retained candidate scores changes his top candidate to holding. This exact live contribution fires once; no score, clock weight or live-term definition changed.

changedCountRows.cause: S130 opted-in reconnaissance records an unknown estimate where some observed enemy strength is unquantified. The current numeric estimate is omitted. In the retained day140 regional Harper goal, perceived opposition changes4630->532 and the direct candidate score140->760; holding stays11. The force-ratio contribution changes-419->201, while time and goal-fit weights/contributions are unchanged. Removing either time or goal-fit used to switch the top pick to holding and now leaves direct on top. This exactly explains both lost live-term firings. The received unknown paper and candidate arithmetic are retained; this combined before/after comparison does not isolate every upstream cause or certify the legacy unknown-estimate fallback.
